title: What Is Taken Now When a ShieldCare Claim Excess Is Settled
content:
## The quantity defined

Where the excess standing against a claim on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is settled:

1. **The excess owed** is the plan's deductible, the amount the customer pays toward an approved claim.
2. **The share the account must meet straight away** is the whole of the excess owed.
3. **The handling charge on an invoiced settlement**: no handling charge is added to an invoiced
   settlement.
4. **The part of the excess deferred**: no part of the excess is deferred.
5. **The delay in billing** is counted to the day the excess stands billed on the plan, and from the day
   the loss was reported.
6. **What is taken now** is the excess owed at the share the account must meet straight away, together
   with the handling charge and less the part deferred, taken to the cent and never below nothing.

The plan's deductible is the figure recorded against that plan.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a plan whose deductible is 99.00, with an excess standing against a claim.

| Component | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| the excess owed | 99.00 |
| the share the account must meet straight away | the whole of it |
| the handling charge | 0.00 |
| the part deferred | 0.00 |
| what is taken now, taken to the cent | 99.00 |

On a plan whose deductible is 49.00 the same reading gives 49.00, and on one whose deductible is nothing it gives nothing. Where the components would leave a
negative figure, what is taken now is nothing, because it is never below nothing.
